reason: Reveal B best supports reading the full forecast and reaching Share at both sizes. History A best balances preview, chronology and entry-level action. Error A gives recovery the clearest priority and strongest enlarged composition. These are provisional composition choices, not implementation acceptance. Component vectors use hierarchy, typography/spacing, surfaces/color, clarity, feedback/recovery, accessibility. A and F are their normalized three-dimension means; overall weights A 40% and F 60%. Screen totals use unrounded means. No option demonstrates the required 9/9 threshold.
limitations: Assessment uses the six attached comparison sheets and supplied evidence descriptions only. No files, prior ratings, other graders or live interactions were inspected.

Component feedback numbers assess visible status, explanation or supplied baseline behavior. Null denotes genuinely inapplicable decorative dimensions or interaction behavior absent from the structural prototype; it does not imply a pass.

Prototype buttons announce study status; they do not demonstrate inference, persistence, sharing, reminders or recovery. Their visible guidance scores cannot certify those tasks. Baseline runtime evidence was not transferred to alternatives.

The captures establish enlargement and visible layout behavior, not exact hit areas, keyboard focus, screen-reader semantics, scroll reachability or transition continuity. Prototype contrast and reduced-motion behavior are not established by static imagery or the reused orb.

Baseline headline fragmentation and the broken History month rail are visible defects. Viewport cropping alone does not prove lost content or an inaccessible action; no hard-gate failure is conclusively established by these sheets.
Baseline and alternatives differ in visible navigation, allowance information and secondary actions. Prototype omissions prevent judging complete product-flow parity.
Physical iPhone and assistive-technology coverage remains deferred. No full/native 9 or 10 certification is made; missing physical proof alone was not used to cap browser composition scores.
